title: Encoding Choices and Fault-Tolerant Resource Estimates for Digital Quantum Hamiltonian Descent
summary: Quantum Hamiltonian descent (QHD) formulates continuous optimization as time-dependent quantum dynamics, where a kinetic term drives exploration and a potential term encodes the objective function. Digital implementations of QHD require encoding the search space into qubits, and this choice can shift the dominant cost among logical qubits, circuit depth, non-Clifford rotations, and potential synthesis.
